description: Search ElevenLabs voices to pick a voice_id for text_to_speech. source 'account' = the user's voices (premade, saved, cloned, designed); 'library' = the public Voice Library (thousands of community voices; paid plans only). Paginated: pass next_page back as page. You can't hear voices, so choose from the labels and description, and offer the user preview_url links when the pick matters.
name: tts_voices

language.description: Filter by ISO 639-1 code, e.g. en.

query.description: Free-text search over names, descriptions and labels, e.g. 'gruff old dwarf'.
